title_zh: 防城港9号泊位3万吨级集装箱进口码头工程初步设计
title_en: Preliminary Design of the No. 9 Berth Container Import Terminal Project in Fangchenggang Port
abstract_zh: 本设计以防城港渔澫港区9号泊位3万吨级集装箱进口码头为对象，按照初步设计深度完成工程概况、设计资料、平面布置、装卸工艺、结构方案、结构计算、工程概预算和方案选择。设计船型取3万吨级集装箱船，泊位长度取300m，码头前沿设计水深取13.50m，停泊水域宽度取65m，回旋水域按500m×400m布置，航道有效宽度取150m。陆域采用前沿作业带、重箱区、空箱区、冷藏箱区、危险品箱区、查验区、铁路装卸区、闸口和道路系统分区布置，装卸工艺推荐岸边集装箱起重机、集装箱牵引车和轮胎式场桥配套方案。结构方案采用沉箱重力式码头和大圆筒重力式码头进行比较，内容包括平面布置、结构断面、细部构造、材料尺度、代表配筋和施工控制。结构计算包括抗滑、抗倾覆、基床应力、偏心距和施工阶段验算，工程概预算按单位工程、主要工程量、综合单价和投资估算编制。综合结构稳定、工程量、概预算、施工风险和运行维护，推荐采用沉箱重力式码头方案。
keywords_zh: 防城港；集装箱码头；初步设计；沉箱码头；大圆筒码头；工程概预算
abstract_en: This thesis presents the preliminary design of the No. 9 berth 30,000 DWT container import terminal in Fangchenggang Port. The work covers project conditions, design data, general layout, handling process, structural schemes, structural calculations, budget estimation and scheme selection. The design vessel is a 30,000 DWT container ship. The berth length is 300 m, the design water depth at the berth front is 13.50 m, the berthing water width is 65 m, the turning basin is 500 m by 400 m, and the channel width is 150 m. The land area is arranged with quay apron, laden container yard, empty container yard, reefer area, dangerous cargo area, inspection area, railway transfer area, gate area and road system. The handling process adopts quay cranes, container tractors and rubber-tyred gantry cranes. Two gravity wharf schemes, namely the caisson scheme and the large-diameter cylinder scheme, are described in terms of layout, sections, local details, dimensions, materials, reinforcement and construction control. Stability checks, foundation stress verification, construction-stage considerations, quantity estimation and budget comparison are completed. Considering structural reliability, construction risk, quantities, budget and maintenance, the caisson gravity wharf scheme is recommended.
keywords_en: Fangchenggang Port; container terminal; preliminary design; caisson wharf; large cylinder wharf; budget estimation
acknowledgement: 本毕业设计得到指导教师和同学的帮助。指导教师在总平面布置、装卸工艺、结构计算和图纸修改方面给予了耐心指导，使我对港口工程初步设计有了更完整的认识。
感谢建筑工程学院各位老师在本科阶段的教学与培养，港口航道与海岸工程专业课程为本次设计提供了必要的理论基础。
